notes.title: Epic Quest - Definitive Edition: Live now!
notes.content:
[p]The wait is finally over: Epic Quest - Definitive Edition is now live!

The game has been completely reworked on an nw.js based engine, with all new assets, enhanced resolution, and some more improvements to the overall game. Here's a complete list of changes:[/p][list][*][p]The overworld has been rebuilt to make the islands a bit more jagged, decorated better, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Safe areas have been given an overhaul in terms of decor, some new buildings have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new towns have been added along with names for each one[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon 1 had a complete visual overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeons 2-6 have been completely redesigned, inspired loosely by original layouts[/p][/*][*][p]A few smaller endgame dungeons have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]An endgame side-quest with a massive dungeon has been added[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies have been redrawn, new variants have been added to some[/p][/*][*][p]New bosses have also been added to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment has been expanded[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue has been rewritten, new dialogue was added for after you get the Hero's Crest[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty has been completely rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]A new soundtrack has been composed for the game by SL3DZ[/p][/*][*][p]Doors have been added, requiring keys to access shortcuts, treasure and sometimes to progress[/p][/*][*][p]The tileset has been redrawn and expanded[/p][/*][*][p]The character sprites have also been redrawn[/p][/*][/list][p]That being said: the price will remain unchanged from the original and the Definitive Edition is just a fancy term for a free update. Version 1.0 is still available for free, now appearing under the "Classic Edition" title. Have fun playing![/p]

notes.title: 3 Days Until Definitive Edition
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, It is once again Jakub from Team Epikugemu, proud to announce that everything we've been preparing is complete and well out of the testing phase. The game's had a fair share of rebalancing done in that timespan, and we hope It'll have been worth the wait. A more detailed changelog will be included in the update announcement, around 12PM, Central European, on the July 31st.[/p][p][/p][p]It's been a wild ride! We're hoping to bring you another project of ours, possibly even of another genre, but for now we'd like to ask in advance for your feedback on the new, completely rebuilt Epic Quest - Definitive Edition, once it releases. More feedback means more chances for me to convince Krzysztof to take the next step in game development and experiment with the genre, so we can bring you a more fleshed out, better experience the next time around.

In the meantime, we've included a little extra in the form of the Definitive Edition avatar set to coexist with the originals - It's crazy just how much a shift in style this tiny also completely changes the visual aesthetic!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/c1d40c35419b8682f37b085d5e92a1b765e5ea41.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Definitive Edition News
notes.content:
[p]Hello, once again it is I, Jakub, bringing to you another load of information on the Definitive Edition of Epic Quest. Let's cut straight to the chase:[/p][p][/p][h2]Difficulty Rebalance[/h2][p]The game will have it's difficulty adjusted to be tougher than the original, but also more manageable. That is: Ideally the necessary grind will be reduced to a minimum, the battles will be tough, but if you know what you're doing you'll be able to win them regardless of your party's levels or equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]Thus, from what I've checked so far, it seems early on you'll also have to be a bit more decisive with your purchases. Do you want to get better equipment to get through battles quicker? Do you wanna stock up on supplies to survive longer? maybe you wanna get a new party member with relatively weak starting equipment but exceling in certain stats? It's all up to you. Thanks to certain enemies now being able to drop supplies including medicine, antidotes and keys, if you play your cards just right, you may be able to beat an entire dungeon on just the stock collected from chests![/p][p][/p][p]Also, certain chests may include a nasty little surprise - consider it a stall or a chance to power up, but regardless beware![/p][p][/p][h2]Side-Content[/h2][p]A whole set of new equipment has been added for the post-game, exclusive to the hero Adam, but others will also get some appreciation in that regard. To collect some of the more powerful loot, you'll be forced to return to previously visited places... and explore new mini-dungeons in addition to one last post-game dungeon that will test your endurance, with all new enemies such as...[/p][p][/p][h3]The Wraith[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/7ffb06b0886ffce56bc4b68df800b29bd948d301.png"][/img][/p][p]These resilient bastards have one purpose: To stop you at all costs. They do hit hard for something that isn't even alive![/p][p][/p][h3]The Sage[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/9bc75bfa4e46a1457d8543403b86e67e1e765fb9.png"][/img][/p][p]These maniacs have come to ruin your day... For you see - They are unlike any other enemy you've encountered thus far. Whereas others will try to kill you, they will instead heal the beasts on their side.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Elusive Darkmetal Slime[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/3a114f834f3c33176a53b6e982ecda8eadec0fe4.png"][/img][/p][p]This one is not a direct threat to you - rather a valuable source of income in the endgame. As such, it will try to flee as soon as it encounters you.[/p][h2][/h2][p]This and more to come, and along with it, attempts at worldbuilding. In the Definitive Edition you will learn:
-Who the legendary hero mentioned in the original was?[/p][p]-What caused the desert town's downfall?[/p][p]-Just what exactly was the Disciple of Antisex's plan?[/p][p]-What's the deal with King Bream?[/p][p][/p][p]When playing the game, be sure to revisit certain places are specific story points. You'll find some people will have different things to say than the first time around, and if you're desperately seeking to max out everything, New Game+ is coming to town![/p][p][/p][h1]COMING JULY 31[/h1][p][/p][p]Last but not least, be sure to wishlist the game if you're interested in playing through the remake! As a reminder: If you bought the game pre-July 31, you'll still be getting the Definitive Edition for free as a replacement for the original in your library, with the original - now dubbed "Classic Edition" available to boot as a separate launch option - this last bit also applies to those who buy it afterwards. Most importantly however, do not rush the purchase if you're not certain about it - We will NOT increase the price when the Definitive Edition drops.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, this was Jakub from Team Epikugemu - Thanks for reading through the announcement, see you again![/p]

notes.title: Now announcing: Definitive Edition
notes.content: [p]This is Jakub from Team Epikugemu - and yes, you've read the title correctly. We proudly announce to you...[/p][p][/p][h1][b]EPIC QUEST - DEFINITIVE EDITION[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]While Krzysztof is working on his own little side-projects, I took up the task of rebuilding the game from the ground up and finally doing it justice. First and foremost: The Definitive Edition will replace the original, free of charge for anyone who previously bought the original release - which will also be included as a separate launch option for anyone curious enough to try it.[/p][p][/p][p]The game will be ported over to a new engine - possibly ensuring compatibility with more systems going forward. It will also now run natively in a 720p resolution and feature a plethora of new content.[/p][p][/p][h2]SAME OLD GAME, FRESH COAT OF PAINT[/h2][p]To make it up to par with another ongoing project's standards, I've gone for my own art direction. No longer does the game look like a 40-year old relic. I took the given liberty to improve the aesthetics, while staying true to the game's roots, but that's not everything there is to it! The change also affects the map design! Have a look at some examples:[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the first overworld section:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/031981c22a340df883b7362c3a20dcb9d0c3e50f.png"][/img][/p][p]The literal first room you see:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/e5629079a380c7eba5187803894bbfdc0228c95a.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the dungeons:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/9bb51c21ae0591e3c076e13ca7004ace382923f1.png"][/img][/p][p]And one of the later towns:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/6534494884b79ab93ef38a0891377dd452f27b0f.png"][/img][/p][p]Much more pleasing to the eye, isn't it? Sure, it may lack some NPCs at the moment, but that'll be resolved soon enough. The other major change in the artstyle are some of the enemy sprites, now looking less like this; and more like this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022118/1d397a3928a2440aa5a1b78b4edce63eaaada95b.png"][/img][/p][p]Already much better, eh?[/p][p][/p][h2]Now in proper 2A03 sound![/h2][p]The original game used a soundtrack comprised of simplified RPG Maker 2000 Midis with an NES soundfont thrown over them - Nothing too bad, nothing to brag about either - Well, that changes today! We're proud to announce a collaboration with SL3DZ to bring you a proper soundtrack fitting the 8-bit system's limitations. Check out the two tracks made for the game that he already published on his YouTube channel![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DyZ6XOHrM2Q;rightthumb"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="QIkRr0aP8Wg;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Your quest, Hero's journey[/h2][p]Now we move on to the really good stuff - The original was, more or less - a better or worse clone of a 40 year old barebones jRPG game. What worked back then is pretty outdated nowadays, and thus - a plot comprised entirely of two major conversations will simply not suffice these days. [/p][p][/p][p]As such, I took it upon myself to expand on it vastly, giving more purpose to things you'll find in the world, more reason as to why you're visiting certain places, quite a few side-quests, and a taste of things to come in the form of postgame content, including many enemies and locations exclusive to the Definitive Edition[/p][p][/p][p]Of course, with the engine change comes a new feature many players were probably waiting for: Achievements! We're preparing 20 different achievements in total, some story progression-based, others rewarding exploration![/p][p][/p][h2]Coming soon![/h2][p]I'll be posting more updates on the remake from time to time, so be on the lookout until then! We're finally giving the game the justice it deserved, by bringing it right to the state it should've been in day 1! Remember - if you previously owned Epic Quest, your game will be updated to Definitive Edition free of charge as soon as it releases! Anyone who buys the game after that point will also be able to play the original 2024 release using the appropriate launch option, or by simply launching it from the game's files.[/p][p][/p][p]This was Jakub from Team Epikugemu, and I'll be seeing you on the flip side when we're ready to show off more progress![/p]

notes.title: The Journey Begins
notes.content:
Venture forth into an unknown world, for your journey has begun! It's time for you to act, and vanquish this world's greatest evil... At least for now.

Buy now, and begin your journey!
